## 👤 About Me

I approach software engineering with a product-first, builder's mindset. My work sits at the intersection of **AI Engineering**, **Computer Vision**, and **Full Stack Development** — building systems that process, understand, and act on real-world data.

I've built real-time facial recognition search engines backed by vector databases, sentiment analysis platforms that surface cognitive patterns, and full-stack applications from backend APIs to polished UIs. My focus is on shipping software that solves tangible problems — from a mental health journaling tool that detects cognitive distortions, to a sports venue booking platform that connects local athletes.

I'm working toward building impactful products that grow from MVP to meaningful scale.

## 🚀 Current Mission

### ⚡ Currently Building

- **MindMirror** — AI-powered mental health journaling & cognitive distortion extraction.
- **CrimeFace** — Real-time facial recognition search connected to Milvus vector indexes.
- **Turfly** — A unified sports booking engine and local player matching platform.

### 📚 Deepening Knowledge

- **Agentic AI** — Multi-agent state orchestration, tool calling and reasoning graphs.
- **RAG Architectures** — Semantic chunking, hybrid keyword/vector search, and reranking pipelines.
- **System Design** — High-concurrency API gateways, caching layers, and distributed architectures.
- **Open Source** — Contributing to mainstream AI developer toolkits.

        <br/>
        <blockquote>
          <b>The Problem:</b> Mental well-being diaries are tedious to maintain, and users rarely notice emotional trends or harmful cognitive distortion patterns without professional analysis.<br/>
          <b>The Solution:</b> An intelligent journaling platform that uses NLP to extract semantic sentiment, logs psychological distortions (e.g., catastrophizing), and generates visual dashboard summaries of mental health state.<br/>
          <b>Tech Stack:</b> React, Node.js, Python (NLTK/Transformers), Tailwind CSS, Firebase Firestore.<br/>
          <b>Current Status:</b> Active refinement. Planning to integrate voice-based journaling with multi-modal tone analysis.
        </blockquote>
      </details>

  <!-- PROJECT 2: CRIMEFACE -->
  <tr>
    <td style="border: none; padding-bottom: 25px;">
      <a href="https://github.com/soham-arch/CrimeFace" target="_blank">
        <img src="assets/svg/project_cards/crimeface_card.svg" alt="CrimeFace Card" width="100%" />
      </a>
      <details>
        <summary><b>🔍 Technical Deep-Dive: CrimeFace</b> (Click to expand)</summary>
        <br/>
        <blockquote>
          <b>The Problem:</b> Video surveillance identification is manual and extremely slow when cross-referencing multi-million record criminal suspect files.<br/>
          <b>The Solution:</b> A low-latency, deep learning-powered facial identification pipeline. Converts CCTV face feeds to high-dimensional embeddings and executes sub-millisecond vector similarity search against a Milvus index.<br/>
          <b>Tech Stack:</b> Python, OpenCV, PyTorch, FastAPI, Milvus, Docker.<br/>
          <b>Current Status:</b> Production-ready. Currently improving occlusion robustness and multi-camera person re-identification.
        </blockquote>
      </details>
    </td>
  </tr>

        <br/>
        <blockquote>
          <b>The Problem:</b> Sports enthusiasts experience friction booking turf courts and assembling enough local players to form matches.<br/>
          <b>The Solution:</b> A mobile booking platform that integrates real-time scheduling APIs with a social matchmaking engine where players can host or join public matches.<br/>
          <b>Tech Stack:</b> React Native, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Google Maps API.<br/>
          <b>Current Status:</b> Deployment phase. Moving to integrate league tournament brackets and group split-payment gateways.
        </blockquote>
      </details>

## 🎯 Developer Philosophy & Roadmap Goals

### 💡 Engineering Philosophy

**1. Build with Purpose:** Coding is a superpower. Every line of code should be aimed at solving a specific friction point or creating concrete utility.

**2. Strive for Simplicity:** Simple architectures scale better, are easier to debug, and survive user growth. Over-engineering is a debt paid in production.

**3. Stay Adaptable:** The AI field changes weekly. A great engineer is not defined by their current stack, but by their speed of adapting to new paradigms.

---

### 🎯 Future Milestones

- **Open Source:** Commit feature integrations to LlamaIndex/LangChain/AutoGen core libraries.
- **Vector DB Architectures:** Implement raw C++ extensions for custom distance metrics in vector search.
- **Micro-SaaS Incubator:** Ship, launch, and validate two AI products to 500+ active users.
- **Mentorship & Sharing:** Write in-depth articles detailing RAG optimization and agentic behaviors.
